title: coffee.embedding
description: One coffee's embedding, from intfloat/multilingual-e5-base: 768 float32 values, carried as base64 of their raw little-endian bytes (3 072 bytes, which is 4 096 base64 characters). The model, dimension and dtype are the contract. A different model, dimension or dtype is a new wire version, never an edit to this schema. The decoded vector must be exactly dimension times the dtype's size in bytes; a JSON Schema cannot express that, so a consumer checks it.

dimension.description: Number of elements in the vector, fixed by the model.

dtype.description: Element type of the vector: IEEE 754 single precision, little-endian.

vector.description: Standard base64 (RFC 4648, padded) of the vector's raw bytes, element after element.
